intent.goal: Install DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 on x570 with a fixed DSH_HOME and the approved working model configuration, then evolve dsh-remote into a reusable multi-instance hub and publish x570 at x570.dsh.onlyservice.io without disrupting the existing zsh.onlyservice.io instance.
non_goals: Copy DSH sessions, workspaces, anonymous IDs, or unrelated local state to x570
Overwrite or delete the existing /home/chriswang/.dsh installation on x570
Centralize model credentials or DSH conversation data on the VPS
Replace unrelated VPS sites, containers, firewall rules, or the existing zsh.onlyservice.io endpoint
Replace SSH reverse forwarding with a new relay protocol

artifacts: VPS Remote Hub registry and generated route configuration
excluded_paths: unrelated VPS Nginx server blocks, containers, DNS records, certificates, and firewall state
integration_subjects: dsh-remote multi-instance package plus x570 and VPS external revisions

authority.destructive_boundary: May create or replace only the new x570 DSH_HOME, user-local DSH launcher, dsh-remote package/profile entries, managed multi-instance Hub files, wildcard dsh.onlyservice.io TLS material, and x570 registration. Preserve x570 ~/.dsh, existing zsh.onlyservice.io, unrelated VPS/DNS state, and all session/workspace data. Model credentials may be transferred only over SSH into a mode-0600 file and must never enter Git, logs, evidence, or command output.

outcome.first_evidence: Fresh evidence proving the x570 rc.6 fixed-home installation and approved model configuration are healthy, while wildcard DNS, the VPS pre-state, and zsh.onlyservice.io remain healthy before Hub mutation.
acceptance: X570-01 As the DSH owner, install DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 on x570 with fixed /home/chriswang/.local/dsh_home and the same usable model configuration, without copying sessions/workspaces or overwriting ~/.dsh.
MDR-01 As the DSH owner, add nodes such as x570 through node-side installation and registration and obtain an independent endpoint.
MDR-02 As the DSH owner, keep each node on an independent domain, socket, token, and state so one node's outage or token rotation does not affect the others.
MDR-03 As the DSH owner, operate one wildcard DNS/TLS and a registry-driven Hub so future nodes require no per-node certificate or manual Nginx editing.
final_evidence: Focused package tests, build, pack, and multi-instance edge fixture
x570 version, fixed-home, permission, hash, model discovery, and local loopback smoke evidence
VPS Nginx validation, registry/status, wildcard certificate renewal check, and exact rollback receipts
Concurrent public HTTP/WebSocket/private-link E2E for zsh.onlyservice.io and x570.dsh.onlyservice.io including isolated offline recovery and token rotation
Task and Wave user-story alignment with drift score 0

recovery.failure_strategy: On x570 failure stop only the new DSH process and restore or remove the new user-local installation while preserving ~/.dsh. On Hub failure restore the exact VPS receipt and prior Nginx/Compose/certificate/cron state. Do not proceed if zsh.onlyservice.io health changes.
recovery.maintenance_window: No shared VPS change until package tests and x570 local smoke pass; validate generated Nginx before atomic activation and reload; keep the existing endpoint continuously available.
recovery.restore_point: Git HEAD 34fa08a with the pre-existing dirty worktree preserved; x570 target DSH_HOME absent and ~/.dsh rc.5 hashes recorded; VPS Nginx/Compose/certificate/cron hashes and current zsh.onlyservice.io readiness captured before mutation.

reason: Correct the approved story baseline so the already-authorized x570 local installation is X570-01 and MDR-01 remains the node registration and independent endpoint outcome; merge Hub implementation and deployment into one observable delivery task. Goal, authority, external targets, protected data, and recovery boundaries are unchanged.
